source.title: Quavo & Takeoff — HOTEL LOBBY | A COLORS SHOW
source.preparation: Nearest original 25 fps frames sampled at 24 fps. Uniform 1920×1080 to 1280×720 scale plus 24-pixel top/bottom pads. Native preparation re-encodes the input. Source audio excluded.

method.selection: SAM3 tracks the selected left performer.
method.replacement: H3 Character Swap V1.5, one reference photo with a face-focus box, seed 509201.
method.composition: Native Comfy ImageCompositeMasked. The SAM3 mask is grown 32 pixels and blurred with radius 3, sigma 1.5; H3 pixels inside, prepared source outside.
method.framing: Identical centered 16/15 native framing removes the known pads and contain sidebars without stretching.
method.ui: Six silent holds from five actual UI screenshots. No cursor, spinner animation or progress values generated. Generation waits omitted.
method.audio: Seven generic local Kokoro af_heart narration clips, speed 1.05. No original song audio.

review.limits: The replacement is generative. Exact likeness, mouth articulation, and universal pixel-identical preservation are not established. Decoded-frame and audio-timing checks do not establish listening quality.

provenance.referenceExposure: Reference-face view inside actual UI screenshots; supply your own portrait for regeneration.
